INSERT INTO group_link_preview ( group_link_id, owner_phone, creator_country_iso2, creator_continent_code, last_preview_at, metadata_observed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
( #{row.groupLinkId}, #{row.ownerPhone}, #{row.creatorCountryIso2}, #{row.creatorContinentCode}, COALESCE(#{row.lastPreviewAt}, #{row.metadataObservedAt}, 0), CASE WHEN #{row.creatorCountryObserved} = TRUE THEN COALESCE(#{row.metadataObservedAt}, 0) ELSE NULL END, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE owner_phone = CASE VALUES(group_link_id)
WHEN #{row.groupLinkId} THEN CASE WHEN #{row.ownerPhoneObserved} = TRUE AND VALUES(last_preview_at) >= COALESCE(last_preview_at, 0) THEN NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(owner_phone)), '') ELSE owner_phone END
ELSE owner_phone END, creator_country_iso2 = CASE VALUES(group_link_id)
WHEN #{row.groupLinkId} THEN CASE WHEN #{row.creatorCountryObserved} = TRUE AND VALUES(metadata_observed_at) >= COALESCE(metadata_observed_at, 0) THEN VALUES(creator_country_iso2) ELSE creator_country_iso2 END
ELSE creator_country_iso2 END, creator_continent_code = CASE VALUES(group_link_id)
WHEN #{row.groupLinkId} THEN CASE WHEN #{row.creatorCountryObserved} = TRUE AND VALUES(metadata_observed_at) >= COALESCE(metadata_observed_at, 0) THEN VALUES(creator_continent_code) ELSE creator_continent_code END
ELSE creator_continent_code END, last_preview_at = GREATEST(COALESCE(last_preview_at, 0), VALUES(last_preview_at)), metadata_observed_at = CASE VALUES(group_link_id)
WHEN #{row.groupLinkId} THEN CASE WHEN #{row.creatorCountryObserved} = TRUE THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(metadata_observed_at, 0), VALUES(metadata_observed_at)) ELSE metadata_observed_at END
ELSE metadata_observed_at END, updated_at = GREATEST(updated_at, VALUES(updated_at))
